title: CUSAT Syndicate backs Higher Education Minister amid SFI protests

ai.summary: The Syndicate of CUSAT expressed support for Higher Education Minister Roji M John amid protests by CPI(M) and SFI against his decisions on autonomous colleges and student suspensions.

facts.claim: The Syndicate of CUSAT has passed a resolution expressing support for Higher Education Minister Roji M John amid protests by the CPI(M) and its student wing SFI
facts.quote: The Syndicate of CUSAT has passed a resolution expressing support for Higher Education Minister Roji M John amid protests by the CPI(M) and its student wing SFI against certain decisions taken by him, officials said on Monday.

facts.claim: A resolution was adopted at a Syndicate meeting held on Friday, extending support to the minister’s efforts to develop the higher education sector, ensure quality education, and improve the academic standards of universities
facts.quote: A statement by Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) said that a resolution was adopted at a Syndicate meeting held on Friday, extending support to the minister’s efforts to develop the higher education sector, ensure quality education, and improve the academic standards of universities.

facts.claim: The Syndicate appreciated his interventions in bringing positive changes to the higher education sector and enhancing academic excellence in universities
facts.quote: The Syndicate appreciated his interventions in bringing positive changes to the higher education sector and enhancing academic excellence in universities, the statement said,

facts.claim: It also condemned activities aimed at obstructing the minister’s work, disrupting official programmes and making what it termed false allegations against him
facts.quote: It also condemned activities aimed at obstructing the minister’s work, disrupting official programmes and making what it termed false allegations against him.

facts.claim: The resolution also endorsed the minister’s approach of prioritising the progress of universities and protecting their academic autonomy in matters concerning higher education
facts.quote: The resolution also endorsed the minister’s approach of prioritising the progress of universities and protecting their academic autonomy in matters concerning higher education, the statement added.

facts.claim: The development comes amid protests by CPI(M) and the Students Federation of India (SFI) against John over two recent issues
facts.quote: The development comes amid protests by the CPI(M) and the Students Federation of India (SFI) against John over two recent issues.

facts.claim: The first concerns a Higher Education Department circular exempting autonomous colleges from obtaining prior government approval or a no-objection certificate (NOC) for introducing new self-financing courses or increasing student intake in existing programmes
facts.quote: The first concerns a Higher Education Department circular exempting autonomous colleges from obtaining prior government approval or a no-objection certificate (NOC) for introducing new self-financing courses or increasing student intake in existing programmes.

facts.claim: The SFI has also been protesting against the minister’s support for the suspension of 16 students of Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit, who had launched an agitation against the Vice-Chancellor and university administration over the alleged lack of adequate facilities on the campus
facts.quote: The SFI has also been protesting against the minister’s support for the suspension of 16 students of Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit, who had launched an agitation against the Vice-Chancellor and university administration over the alleged lack of adequate facilities on the campus.

ai.background_note: CUSAT Syndicate supports Higher Education Minister amid student protests over academic autonomy and university management.
